analysis.summary: Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited reported strong financial and operational performance for FY 2025-26, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 933.65 Crore and Profit After Tax rising to Rs. 70.07 Crore. The company achieved its highest-ever annual bus sales of 9,328 units and marked the historical milestone of rolling out its 100,000th bus. Management highlighted ongoing initiatives in capacity enhancement, digital transformation, and sustainability, including renewable energy adoption and water conservation projects.

demand_outlook.claim: The long-term outlook for the Indian commercial vehicles sector remains positive.
demand_outlook.quote: Despite these external challenges, the long-term outlook for the Indian commercial vehicles sector continues to remain positive.

demand_outlook.claim: India's long-term growth outlook and urban mobility requirements continue to create significant industry opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: At ACGL, we remain committed to building a resilient and responsible organisation anchored in operational excellence, innovation, sustainability and customer trust.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a 500 kWp rooftop solar plant at Plant 2 in Goa and an 805 kWp rooftop solar project at Jejuri.
capex_expansion.quote: During the year, ACGL commissioned a 500 kWp rooftop solar plant at Plant 2 in Goa and operationalised an 805 kWp rooftop solar project at Jejuri.

capex_expansion.claim: A 500kWp solar project is under installation for the Goa Plant's Bus Body Division at Bhuimpal.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company is also in the process of installing a 500kWp of solar project for the Goa Plant’s Bus Body Division at Sattari village in Bhuimpal, Goa.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of installing an organic waste composter to manage food waste.
capex_expansion.quote: To manage its food waste, the Company is in the process of installing a Organic Waste Composter that will treat the food waste and generate organic waste compost, preventing it from being disposed direct into landfills.

capex_expansion.claim: An artificial water body is being constructed with a storage capacity of 72 lakh litres of water.
capex_expansion.quote: To conserve water, an Artficial Water Body is being constructed with a storage capacity of 72 lakh litres of water, which will store rain water during the monsoon.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved its highest-ever annual bus sales of 9,328 units.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved its highest-ever annual bus sales of 9,328 units as against 7,265 units in the previous year, while revenue from operations increased significantly from Rs. 660.77 Crores to Rs. 933.65 Crores.

orders_capacity.claim: The company increased its installed manufacturing capacity to 1,200 buses per month.
orders_capacity.quote: To support future growth opportunities, the Company undertook significant capacity enhancement initiatives during the year, increasing installed manufacturing capacity of 1,200 buses per month with higher percentage of bus bodies built on MCV platform which includes STUs.

orders_capacity.claim: During FY23-24, ACGL manufactured a total of 6,511 buses, including 3904 school buses and 122 buses for a major State Transport Undertaking.
orders_capacity.quote: In FY23-24, ACGL manufactured a total of 6,511 buses, including 3904 school buses and 122 buses for a major State Transport Undertaking.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of Rs. 22.50 per equity share for the financial year.
capital_allocation.quote: To declare Final Dividend of Rs. 22.50/- per equity share of the face value of Rs.10/- each (i.e.225%) of the Company for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global environment remained volatile due to geopolitical uncertainties, supply chain disruptions, and fluctuations in commodity and energy prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, the global environment remained volatile due to geopolitical uncertainties, supply chain disruptions, and fluctuations in commodity and energy prices, particularly towards the close of the financial year following developments in the Middle East region.

management_commitments.claim: The company targeted to reduce waste being sent to landfills as part of its quest to create a sustainable environment by FY 2025-26.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has targeted to reduce the waste being sent to landfills as part of its quest to create a sustainable environment.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
